The 'Molded details' checkpoint was correctly marked false; the lack of screw holes and sharp write-protect tabs is a significant geometric simplification typical of AI generation. The 'Rectangular opening' checkpoint was marked present, but the Router noted it lacks sharp edges; I agree it is present in form but defective in quality.

The text auditor confirms low confidence scores (<0.65) for most text blocks, validating the gibberish classification. The topology auditor shows a clean mask, suggesting the overall silhouette is intact, but this masks the internal geometric softness noted by the Router. The perceptual auditor notes slight blur, which aligns with the 'waxy' or 'soft' appearance of the plastic molding. I would elevate the severity of the text artifact to 3.5 as it fundamentally breaks the realism of the object's primary information surface.

These failures prevent a high alignment score despite the correct general shape and components.

Additionally, there is structural softness/collapse in the tape head opening and melted/distorted textures on the background cassette spines (Router severity 2). The plastic surfaces lack the crisp, hard-edged definition of real injection-molded plastic, appearing slightly waxy or blurred (perceptual auditor). These issues compound to lower the artifact score significantly below the reference high-quality image.
